description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the ViewMultiedit class in the SuiteCRM project. It verifies the behavior of the ViewMultiedit view component, ensuring it is instantiated correctly and that its display method produces expected output under different conditions.

classes.name: ViewMultieditTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the ViewMultiedit class in the SuiteCRM project. It contains methods to test instantiation and display behavior of the view.

methods.name: testViewMultiedit
methods.description: Tests whether the ViewMultiedit class can be instantiated correctly, and verifies its class type and the 'type' property value.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Tests the display method of ViewMultiedit under different scenarios, including default behavior, with action and module set, and with modules in REQUEST. It captures output buffering to verify rendered content.
